# Problems found by `run` read as plain language, with the line.
# (from diagnostics_golden and internal_error)

# problems stop the run, and it says how many more there are
! exec metagente run bad.ag go
stderr 'agent Bad has no goal'
stderr '\(2 more problems in this file; run `metagente check bad\.ag` to see them all\)'

# a message the agent does not accept, and one with a value missing
! exec metagente run hello.ag shout name=Ana
stderr 'does not accept the message `shout`'
stderr 'hello accepts: greet|Hello accepts: greet'
! exec metagente run hello.ag greet
stderr 'needs a value for `name`'
! exec metagente run hello.ag greet name=Ana extra=1
stderr 'does not take `extra`'

# fail stops the agent with its own words, on its line
! exec metagente run failing.ag go
stderr 'Problem on line 5 of failing\.ag: I need a city'

# think without a language model set up says what to set up
! exec metagente run thinker.ag go
stderr 'this agent needs a language model to think, and none is set up'
stderr '\[llm\] section'

# a tool server nobody approved is not started
! exec metagente run mcp.ag go
stderr 'have not approved for this project'
stderr 'starts the program: weather-mcp@1\.0\.0'

# a missing file, and a broken configuration
! exec metagente run nope.ag
stderr 'I could not open nope\.ag: the file does not exist'
! exec metagente run hello.ag name=Ana --config broken.toml
stderr 'Problem on line 2 of broken\.toml'

-- bad.ag --
agent Bad
  accepts go
  on go
    x = nme
    reply q
-- hello.ag --
agent Hello
  goal "Say hello to someone"
  accepts greet name
  on greet
    reply "Hello, {name}!"
-- failing.ag --
agent F
  goal "x"
  accepts go
  on go
    fail "I need a city"
-- thinker.ag --
agent T
  goal "x"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply think "hi"
-- mcp.ag --
agent M
  goal "x"
  tool weather from mcp "weather-mcp@1.0.0"
  accepts go
  on go
    r = weather.forecast city: "x"
    reply r
-- broken.toml --
[runtime]
timeout_seconds = soon
